OpenCV %1$s · 640×480 NV21 preview · Multi-cascade fusion (2 frontal + profile + feature verification, 4.7MB total) · DetectionBasedTracker

① Face detection (Viola-Jones framework, Ch. 11): Haar rectangle features (brightness differences) + O(1) integral-image region sums + AdaBoost selecting the most discriminative weak classifiers + a cascade structure that rejects non-face windows stage by stage.
② Multi-cascade fusion for higher detection rate (Ch. 9 model library of the requirements doc, 4.7MB total < 5MB): union of two frontal models haarcascade_frontalface_default + frontalface_alt2 — trained with different emphases, a hit from either is kept; the profile model haarcascade_profileface scans both the original and horizontally flipped image to cover left/right profile faces — head turns are the main miss cause of a single frontal model; multi-model results are clustered by IoU and averaged per cluster.
③ Facial-feature verification to cut false positives: a larger candidate must contain eyes (haarcascade_eye) in its upper part, or both nose (haarcascade_nose) and mouth (haarcascade_mouth), to be confirmed as a face; profile candidates skip verification. (Note: the mcs_nose/mcs_mouth models listed in Ch. 9 use the legacy OpenCV 2 format whose feature rectangles overflow the training window — OpenCV 4 throws on load — so verified compatible equivalents are used instead.)
④ Detection parameters tuned for recall: scaleFactor=1.08 for finer multi-scale scanning, minNeighbors=3, minimum face 48px; the full-frame scan internally downsamples by 0.5 (scan at 320×240, boxes mapped back), so the multi-model union costs about the same as one full-resolution model.
⑤ Illumination adaptation: CLAHE locally adaptive histogram equalization (clipLimit=2.0), more robust to backlight/side light/shadows than global equalization.
⑥ Hybrid detection & tracking (DetectionBasedTracker): the main detector periodically scans the full frame with all cascades on a background thread; between full scans, faces are re-detected only in tracked neighborhoods (first frontal + profile models) with weighted position smoothing — real-time performance with stable, continuous tracking boxes.
⑦ Data pipeline (ported from ManiiuFace): camera NV21 frame → YUV2RGBA_NV21 → rotation/mirror correction (front camera as mirrored selfie) → grayscale → CLAHE → detection & tracking → red box drawing → ANativeWindow row-by-row rendering (stride aligned); detection, drawing and display all run on the preview callback thread.
